controlling_rule: WIP_OR_ESTIMATE != ISSUED_INVOICE != PROFORMA != PAGARE != CASH_PAYMENT. No amount moves between categories without a source-backed bridge.

definitions.wip: Work recorded, accrued or valued internally but not yet issued as a final invoice.
definitions.estimate: Forward-looking estimate; not necessarily work already performed.
definitions.proforma: Pre-invoice or collection instrument; not treated as an issued tax invoice unless the final invoice is identified.
definitions.pagare: Separate negotiable instrument whose legal cause and allocation to underlying work must be evidenced independently.
definitions.issued_invoice: Final invoice identified by invoice number and native face amount.
